servers.name: Calculator (TypeScript)
servers.summary: Simple arithmetic calculator MCP server written in TypeScript
servers.description:
Provides basic arithmetic operations (add, subtract, multiply, divide) via MCP tools.
Built with the official @modelcontextprotocol/sdk TypeScript SDK.
servers.author: YakupAtahanov

tools.name: subtract
tools.description: Subtract the second number from the first

tools.name: divide
tools.description: Divide the first number by the second
